words.en: If you describe someone or something as trusty, you mean that they have been reliable in the past and you can depend on them.

words.tr: adj. 不会下沉的，不会沉底的
words.ex: The Titanic was deemed unsinkable, but it tragically sank on its maiden voyage.
words.ex_cn: 泰坦尼克号被认为是不会沉没的，但它在其处女航中却悲惨地沉没了。
words.en: If something is unsinkable, it is designed or built in such a way that it cannot sink.

words.ex: The vertebra supports the spine.
words.ex_cn: 椎骨支撑着脊柱。
words.en: A vertebra is one of the small bones that form the spine.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: The old mill uses a waterwheel to grind corn.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊用水车来磨玉米。
words.en: A waterwheel is a large wheel that is turned by water flowing past it and is used to drive machinery or generate electricity.

words.ex: The duck has webbed feet.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子有蹼足。
words.en: Having toes connected by a thin piece of skin, as in ducks and other aquatic birds, or resembling a web or network.

words.ex: He loves zoology and studies animals in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱动物学，研究野外的动物。
words.en: Zoology is the scientific study of animals.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 多得不值钱的；随处可见的；极为普通的
words.ex: In today's market, software engineers are a dime a dozen.
words.ex_cn: 在当今的市场上，软件工程师多得很，不稀罕。
words.en: If you say that something is a dime a dozen, you mean that it is very common and not at all special or unusual.

words.ex: He is at heart a kind man.
words.ex_cn: 他本质上是个善良的人。
words.en: If you say that someone has a particular quality at heart, you mean that it is a basic and important part of their character, even though they may not always show it.

words.tr: phrase. 在那时；在那个时刻；在那个阶段
words.ex: At that point, I realized I had made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 在那时，我意识到我犯了一个错误。
words.en: At that particular moment or stage in a process or sequence of events.

words.tr: phrase. 开创先河；取得突破性进展；开辟新领域
words.ex: The scientist's research breaks new ground in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家的研究在医学上开辟了新领域。
words.en: To do something innovative that has not been done before.

words.tr: phrase. v. 编造某事；临时拼凑出某物；快速做出（食物等）
words.ex: He cooked up a story about being stuck in traffic.
words.ex_cn: v. 他编造了一个关于堵车的故事。
words.en: To invent or prepare something, especially food, quickly or hastily.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 策划；编造；临时凑成
words.ex: She decided to cook up a story to explain her absence.
words.ex_cn: 她决定编造一个故事来解释她的缺席。
words.en: If someone cooks up a story or excuse, they invent it, often to deceive someone.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人远远甩在后面；使某人望尘莫及
words.ex: The new model of the car has left its competitors in the dust.
words.ex_cn: 这款新车已经远远超过了它的竞争对手。
words.en: To surpass someone by a large margin, making them seem far behind in comparison.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的；许多的；充裕的
words.ex: She has oodles of money.
words.ex_cn: 她有大量的钱。
words.en: A large amount or number of something.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text A New Words

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.tr:
v. 怒吼；吼叫；咆哮
n. 咆哮；怒号
words.ex: The bull bellowed loudly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 公牛在田野里大声吼叫。
words.en: If someone bellows, they shout angrily in a loud, deep voice.

words.tr: adj. 官僚的；官僚主义的；
words.ex: The bureaucratic process made it hard to get a permit.
words.ex_cn: 官僚程序让申请许可证变得困难。
words.en: If you describe a system, organization, or process as bureaucratic, you mean that it is complicated and inefficient because of a large number of rules and procedures.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.tr: n. 城市风光照片（或绘画）
words.ex: He loves to paint the cityscape at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在晚上画城市景观。
words.en: A cityscape is a view or picture of a city, especially at night or from a distance.

words.ex: He used a cliche to describe the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个陈词滥调来形容日落。
words.en: A cliché is an idea or phrase that has been used so much that it is no longer interesting or effective.

words.tr: n. 板条箱；箱子；篓；破旧的飞机或汽车；
words.ex: The apples were packed in a wooden crate.
words.ex_cn: 苹果被装在一个木板条箱里。
words.en: A crate is a large box used for transporting or storing goods.

words.tr:
adj. 牛奶的；乳品的；
n. 乳品店；
words.ex: She bought dairy products from the local farm.
words.ex_cn: 她从当地农场买了乳制品。
words.en: A dairy is a place where milk and cream are kept or where butter and cheese are made.

words.ex: He felt ecstasy after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得奖品后感到无比喜悦。
words.en: Ecstasy is a feeling of very great happiness.

words.ex: The ever-increasing noise makes it hard to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 不断增加的噪音让人难以入睡。
words.en: Continuously becoming greater in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The ever-present threat of terrorism keeps everyone on edge.
words.ex_cn: 经常存在的恐怖主义威胁让每个人都处于紧张状态。
words.en: Always existing or available; constantly encountered.

words.tr:
v. 嬉戏
n. 嬉戏；欢乐的活动
words.ex: The children were frolicking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里嬉戏。
words.en: If people or animals frolic, they play or move in a lively, happy way.

words.ex: The computer had a small glitch during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 演示过程中电脑出现了一个小故障。
words.en: A glitch is a small problem or fault that prevents something from working correctly.

words.tr: adj. 可想象的；可能的；可想到的
words.ex: That was the worst thing imaginable.
words.ex_cn: 那是所能想象到的最糟糕的事情。
words.en: If something is imaginable, you are able to imagine it or believe that it could exist or happen.

words.tr: adj. 很长的；漫长的；冗长的；
words.ex: The meeting was lengthy and tiring.
words.ex_cn: 会议很长，很累人。
words.en: Something that is lengthy lasts for a long time, often longer than you want or expect.

words.ex: He is studying linguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习语言学。
words.en: Linguistics is the scientific study of language and its structure, including the study of morphology, syntax, phonetics, and semantics.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.ex: He has an obsessive need to clean everything.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强迫性的需求，要把一切都打扫干净。
words.en: If someone's behaviour is obsessive, they cannot stop doing a particular thing or behaving in a particular way.

words.tr:
v. 渗出；流出；分泌出
n. 软泥；淤泥；泥浆
words.ex: Mud is oozing from the hole.
words.ex_cn: 泥巴正从洞里渗出来。
words.en: If a liquid oozes from something or if something oozes a liquid, the liquid flows from it slowly and in small quantities.

words.tr: n. 局外人；无取胜希望者；
words.ex: He felt like an outsider at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上感觉像个局外人。
words.en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.tr: adj. （尤指水果等）过分成熟的，熟透的，熟过的
words.ex: The banana is overripe and smells sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这根香蕉过熟了，闻起来很甜。
words.en: Overripe describes something, especially fruit, that is too ripe and has started to decay or ferment.

words.ex: She wore a parisian style hat.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一顶巴黎风格的帽子。
words.en: Of or relating to Paris or its inhabitants.

words.ex: The dark passageway led to the basement.
words.ex_cn: 这条黑暗的通道通向地下室。
words.en: A passageway is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.ex: They pave the road with stones.
words.ex_cn: 他们用石头铺路。
words.en: To cover a piece of ground with a hard, flat surface of pieces of stone, concrete, etc.

words.ex: There is a plethora of choices on the menu.
words.ex_cn: 菜单上有太多的选择。
words.en: A plethora of something is a very large quantity of it, especially an amount that is greater than you need, want, or can cope with.

words.ex: The village has a quaint old church.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有一座古色古香的古老教堂。
words.en: Something that is quaint is attractive because it is unusual and old-fashioned.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.tr: adj. 平静的；宁静的；安详的
words.ex: The lake is serene in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: Calm, peaceful, and untroubled; tranquil.

words.tr:
n. 一小口；
v. 呷；啜；小口喝；
words.ex: He took a sip of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一小口水。
words.en: To drink something slowly by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.tr: adj. 永恒的；永远的；长期有效的
words.ex: This song has a timeless melody.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌有着永恒的旋律。
words.en: If you describe something as timeless, you mean that it is so good or beautiful that it cannot be affected by changes in society or fashion.

words.tr: adj. 正在进行中的；航行中的；
words.ex: The project is underway.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If something is underway, it is happening now.

words.ex: The children are vibrant and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们充满活力。
words.en: If you describe something as vibrant, you mean that it is bright, lively, and full of energy.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 融入；与……融为一体；自然地结合到……中
words.ex: The bird can blend into the trees because it is the same color as the leaves.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟因为颜色和树叶一样，所以能融入树中。
words.en: To mix or combine so that the separate parts or elements become indistinguishable from each other, especially to become part of a whole or to fit in with one's surroundings.

words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.ex: I dream about flying every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上都梦见在飞行。
words.en: To have a series of thoughts, images, or emotions occurring during sleep, or to think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 与…对齐；使符合；使与…一致
words.ex: Please line the cups with paper before filling them.
words.ex_cn: 在装满杯子之前，请先用纸衬在里面。
words.en: To provide something with a border or edge, often for decoration or reinforcement.

words.tr: phrase. 用某物衬里；在某物内部铺衬；给某物加内衬
words.ex: She lined the box with soft cloth to protect the fragile items.
words.ex_cn: 她用软布填充盒子以保护易碎物品。
words.en: To cover the inner surface of something with a layer of a different material.

words.tr: phrase. 大量生产；快速涌出；用泵抽出；泵出
words.ex: The factory pumps out thousands of toys every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每天大量生产数千件玩具。
words.en: To produce or supply something in large quantities, often quickly and continuously.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text B New Words

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.tr:
n. 巨浪；如巨浪翻腾的东西
v. （像巨浪般）汹涌；翻腾
words.ex: The billow crashed against the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 巨浪拍打着岩石。
words.en: A billow is a large wave or surge of water. It can also refer to the act of swelling or rolling like a wave.

words.tr: v. 打电话；“call”的现在分词；叫； n. 职业；
words.ex: He is calling his mother now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A strong urge toward a particular way of life or career; a vocation.

words.tr: adj. （房间、饭桌）点蜡烛的，用烛光照明的
words.ex: The restaurant was candlelit, creating a romantic atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅里点着蜡烛，营造出一种浪漫的氛围。
words.en: Illuminated by the light of candles.

words.ex: We went to the carnival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了嘉年华。
words.en: A carnival is a public festival, typically one held annually in a particular place, involving processions, music, and dancing.

words.tr: n. 薄脆饼干；爆竹；迷人的姑娘；黑客
words.ex: He ate a cracker with cheese.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块饼干配奶酪。
words.en: A cracker is a thin, crisp biscuit which is often eaten with cheese, or a person who is very good at something, especially solving problems or puzzles.

words.ex: She ate a crisp apple for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个脆苹果当点心。
words.en: Something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.tr: adj. 实际的；脚踏实地的
words.ex: He is a down-to-earth man who helps everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个脚踏实地的人，乐于帮助每个人。
words.en: If you say that someone is down-to-earth, you approve of the fact that they concern themselves with practical things and actions, rather than with abstract theories.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.ex: His eccentricity makes him unique.
words.ex_cn: 他的古怪使他与众不同。
words.en: The quality of being eccentric; behaviour that is unusual, peculiar, or odd.

words.ex: He edits the school newspaper every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周编辑校报。
words.en: To prepare written material for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.

words.ex: The company is a legal entity.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是一个法律实体。
words.en: An entity is something that exists separately from other things and has a clear identity of its own.

words.tr: adj. 令人兴奋的； v. “exhilarate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The roller coaster ride was exhilarating.
words.ex_cn: 过山车之旅令人兴奋。
words.en: If you describe something as exhilarating, you mean that it makes you feel very happy and excited.

words.tr: v. 符合；“fit”的现在分词； adj. 恰当的；适合的；
words.ex: This shoe fits my foot perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋很合我的脚。
words.en: Appropriate or suitable for a particular purpose, person, occasion, etc.

words.ex: He fries fish in a pan every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日用平底锅油炸鱼。
words.en: To cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in this way.

words.tr: adj. 富有魅力的；迷人的；
words.ex: She wore a glamorous dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条富有魅力的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as glamorous, you mean that they are more attractive, exciting, or interesting than ordinary people or things.

words.tr: adj. 变荣耀的，美其名的; v. 赞美；美化（glorify 的过去分词）
words.ex: He calls his job a glorified babysitter.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的工作称为一个被夸大的保姆。
words.en: If you describe something as glorified, you mean that it is considered to be more important or special than it really is.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful gown to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件漂亮的礼服去参加婚礼。
words.en: A gown is a long, loose piece of clothing worn on formal occasions or by people in particular professions.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.tr: adj. 令人紧张不安的；令人胆怯的；
words.ex: The big dog looked intimidating to the small child.
words.ex_cn: 那只大狗看起来让小孩子感到紧张不安。
words.en: Something that is intimidating makes you feel nervous and frightened because it is very difficult, dangerous, or extreme.

words.tr:
adj. 拉丁语的；拉丁语系国家的；
n. 拉丁语；
words.ex: He read a latin text in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上读了一篇拉丁语文本。
words.en: Latin is the language of ancient Rome and its empire, widely used historically as a language of scholarship and administration.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.ex: He bought a lottery ticket last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一张彩票。
words.en: A lottery is a type of gambling game in which people buy numbered tickets. Several numbers are then chosen, and the people who have those numbers on their tickets win a prize.

words.ex: The dragon is a mythical creature.
words.ex_cn: 龙是一种神话中的生物。
words.en: Something that is mythical exists only in myths and is therefore imaginary.

words.ex: The toy store sells many novelty items for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具店出售许多为儿童设计的新奇物品。
words.en: The quality of being new, original, or unusual; something new, original, or unusual.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.tr: adj. 热情的；充满热情的；
words.ex: She is passionate about teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她对教孩子充满热情。
words.en: Having, showing, or caused by strong feelings or beliefs.

words.ex: He said a prayer before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前做了一次祈祷。
words.en: A prayer is a form of religious practice in which people communicate with a deity or spirit, often to ask for help or to give thanks.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.tr: adj. 骚乱的；喧闹的；热烈的
words.ex: The crowd was tumultuous during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人群喧闹不安。
words.en: A tumultuous event or period of time involves many exciting and confusing events or feelings.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: He was utterly surprised by the news.
words.ex_cn: 他全然没想到这个消息。
words.en: completely or totally

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 白日梦；幻想；不切实际的愿望
words.ex: Winning the lottery is just a pipe dream for most people.
words.ex_cn: 对于大多数人来说，赢得彩票只是一个白日梦。
words.en: A pipe dream is an idea or plan that is impossible or very unlikely to happen.

words.tr: phrase. v. 为某人加油；鼓励某人继续努力
words.ex: The crowd cheered the runners on as they approached the finish line.
words.ex_cn: 当选手们接近终点线时，人群为他们加油鼓劲。
words.en: To encourage someone with shouts of support or applause, especially in a sports event.

words.tr: 短语动词. 挂电话；结束通话
words.ex: He needs to get off the phone to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要挂掉电话去做作业。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation.

words.ex: He has nothing but praise for his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师只有赞美。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is only what you say it is and nothing more

words.tr: phrasal verb. 追捕并找到；彻底搜寻以抓获或发现
words.ex: The police will hunt down the thief.
words.ex_cn: 警察将追捕那个小偷。
words.en: To search for someone or something persistently until they are found.

words.ex: The birds of prey flew high above the forest.
words.ex_cn: 猛禽在森林上方高高飞翔。
words.en: Birds of prey are birds that hunt and feed on other animals. They are characterized by their keen eyesight, powerful talons, and beaks designed for tearing flesh.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text A New Words

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.ex: The problem has too much complexity.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题太复杂了。
words.en: Complexity is the state of having many different parts connected or related to each other in a complicated way.

words.ex: He is confined to his room because he is sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病被限制在房间里。
words.en: If you confine something or someone, you limit them to a particular place or situation.

words.ex: He felt contentment after a simple dinner with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他在与家人共进一顿简单的晚餐后感到满足。
words.en: Contentment is a feeling of happiness and satisfaction.

words.tr: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；悲观的；
words.ex: He gave a cynical smile when they talked about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 当他们谈到诚实时，他露出了愤世嫉俗的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as cynical, you mean they believe that people always act selfishly.

words.ex: He will depart tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他明天早上离开。
words.en: If you depart from a place, you leave it and start a journey to another place.

words.tr: adj. 不开心的，生气的，被得罪了的 v. 冒犯，使生气，使不愉快( displease的过去式和
words.ex: She was clearly displeased with the outcome.
words.ex_cn: 她显然对结果感到不高兴。
words.en: If you are displeased with something, you are not satisfied with it or not happy about it.

words.ex: She embellished the dress with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用花朵装饰了这条裙子。
words.en: To embellish something means to make it more attractive by adding decorative details or features.

words.tr: n. 魅力；痴迷；陶醉；魔法
words.ex: The old castle was filled with a sense of enchantment.
words.ex_cn: 那座古老的城堡充满了迷人的气息。
words.en: A feeling of great pleasure or delight; a magical spell or influence.

words.ex: He is going to marry his fiancée next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要和未婚妻结婚。
words.en: A woman who is engaged to be married.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He looked furtively around before taking the cookie.
words.ex_cn: 他拿饼干前偷偷地看了看四周。
words.en: If you do something furtively, you do it in a way that shows you want to keep it secret or hidden, often because it is wrong or you are ashamed.

words.tr:
n. 灰色；
adj. 灰色的；暗淡的；
words.ex: The sky turned gray before the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前，天空变成了灰色。
words.en: Gray is an intermediate color between black and white, often associated with gloom or dullness.

words.tr: n. 宾馆；小型家庭旅馆；
words.ex: We stayed in a small guesthouse near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在火车站附近的一家小宾馆。
words.en: A guesthouse is a small hotel or a private house offering accommodation to paying guests.

words.ex: He cooked the meal with gusto.
words.ex_cn: 他做这顿饭时很有兴趣。
words.en: If you do something with gusto, you do it with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.tr: adj. 恼怒的；生气的； v. “irritate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was irritated by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被那阵噪音惹恼了。
words.en: If something irritates you, it keeps annoying you.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.ex: She has many knick-knacks on her shelf.
words.ex_cn: 她的架子上有很多小摆设。
words.en: A knick-knack is a small, decorative object, especially one that is not particularly valuable or useful.

words.ex: The lamasery is a place of worship for Tibetan Buddhists.
words.ex_cn: 喇嘛庙是藏传佛教徒的礼拜场所。
words.en: A lamasery is a monastery for lamas, which are Buddhist monks or priests in Tibet and Mongolia.

words.ex: He is loitering near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他正在公园附近闲逛。
words.en: If someone loiters somewhere, they remain there or walk up and down without any real purpose.

words.ex: The monks live in a quiet monastery.
words.ex_cn: 僧侣们住在一座安静的修道院里。
words.en: A monastery is a building or collection of buildings in which monks live and work.

words.ex: The view from the hill is panoramic.
words.ex_cn: 从山上望去，景色一览无余。
words.en: A panoramic view or picture is one that shows a wide area of land or sea.

words.tr:
v. 喘气；喘息
n. 气喘；喘息
words.ex: He panted after running up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑上楼梯后喘着气。
words.en: To breathe quickly and loudly through your mouth, usually because you have been doing something energetic.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: The puffball mushroom releases a cloud of spores when touched.
words.ex_cn: 马勃菌在触碰时会释放出一团孢子。
words.en: A puffball is a type of fungus that has a spherical shape and releases a cloud of spores when it matures and is disturbed.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.tr:
n. 马鞍；鞍座
v. 给（马）装鞍
words.ex: The boy rode on a saddle on the horse.
words.ex_cn: 男孩骑在马的马鞍上。
words.en: A saddle is a seat for a rider on the back of a horse or other animal, or a similar seat on a bicycle or motorcycle. It can also refer to the act of putting a saddle on a horse or to burden someone with a responsibility.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 眯着眼看；斜视
n. 斜视；一瞥
words.ex: He squints to see the small letters.
words.ex_cn: 他眯着眼睛看那些小字。
words.en: To squint means to look at something with your eyes partly closed in order to see better, or because of bright light. It can also refer to a condition where the eyes do not look in the same direction.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.ex: The toddler is walking slowly by the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这个幼儿正慢慢地在沙发旁走路。
words.en: A toddler is a young child who has just learned to walk or who is learning to walk.

words.tr: adj. 适宜游览的，适合观光的，旅游者常去的
words.ex: This street is very touristy with many souvenirs.
words.ex_cn: 这条街非常商业化，有很多纪念品。
words.en: If you describe a place as touristy, you mean that it is popular with tourists but often not in a good way because it is too crowded or too expensive.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语. 一线（希望、光亮等）；微弱的迹象或希望
words.ex: There was a glimmer of hope in the darkest hour.
words.ex_cn: 在最黑暗的时刻，出现了一丝希望。
words.en: A glimmer of something is a faint sign of it.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 悄悄接近某人；不知不觉地影响某人
words.ex: The cat creeps up on the bird quietly.
words.ex_cn: 猫悄悄地靠近那只鸟。
words.en: To approach someone or something quietly and stealthily, or to affect someone gradually without being noticed.

words.tr: phrase. 在远处；在外地；远离原地
words.ex: He wandered far afield in search of adventure.
words.ex_cn: 他为了寻找冒险而远行。
words.en: To or at a great distance, especially from home or from a place considered central.

words.tr: phrase. 更远的地方；在更远的区域
words.ex: We had to look farther afield to find a suitable school for our children.
words.ex_cn: 我们不得不在更远的地方寻找一所适合孩子的学校。
words.en: To a greater distance or in a wider area.

words.tr: phrase. 更远的地方；在较远的地区
words.ex: They went further afield to find better schools.
words.ex_cn: 他们去更远的地方寻找更好的学校。
words.en: To or at a greater distance, especially beyond the usual or original limits.

words.ex: The road begins to flatten out as you approach the coast.
words.ex_cn: 当你接近海岸时，道路开始逐渐变平。
words.en: To make or become flat or flatter.

words.tr: phrase. 全面展开；正热火朝天；处于高潮阶段
words.ex: The party was in full swing by the time we arrived.
words.ex_cn: 我们到达时，派对正进行得热火朝天。
words.en: If something is in full swing, it is operating fully or has reached its peak level of activity.

words.tr: phrase. 随着……跳动；因……而搏动；充满（活力、情感等）
words.ex: The city streets pulse with life at night.
words.ex_cn: v. 城市的街道在夜晚充满了生机。
words.en: To be filled with or characterized by a strong rhythm, energy, or feeling.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text B New Words

words.ex: The aroma of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味充满了厨房。
words.en: An aroma is a strong, pleasant smell.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.tr: adj. 又苦又甜的；苦乐参半的；
words.ex: The goodbye party was bittersweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个告别派对又苦又甜。
words.en: If you describe an experience as bittersweet, you mean that it has both happy and sad aspects.

words.tr: adj. 无忧无虑的；轻松愉快的；
words.ex: The children played carefree in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里无忧无虑地玩耍。
words.en: If you are carefree, you have no worries or responsibilities, and you are happy and relaxed.

words.tr: vi.abbr. Carbon-Arc Welding 碳弧焊 vi. 发出鸦叫声
words.ex: The crow cawed loudly in the early morning.
words.ex_cn: 乌鸦在清晨大声地叫着。
words.en: The sound made by a crow or similar bird.

words.tr: phrase. 切达奶酪（一种质地较硬、味道浓郁的黄色奶酪）
words.ex: He eats cheddar cheese on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上吃切达奶酪。
words.en: Cheddar cheese is a type of hard, yellowish or white cheese originally made in the English village of Cheddar, in Somerset.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of clam chowder for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗蛤蜊浓汤。
words.en: A soup or stew, especially one made with seafood, such as clams or fish.

words.ex: She bought a chrysanthemum for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲买了一朵菊花。
words.en: A chrysanthemum is a large, showy flower that is commonly found in gardens and used in floral arrangements. It is known for its wide variety of colors and forms.

words.ex: She added cinnamon to the cookies.
words.ex_cn: 她往饼干里加了肉桂。
words.en: Cinnamon is a spice obtained from the inner bark of several tree species from the genus Cinnamomum. It is used in both sweet and savory foods.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: The boy walks through a cornfield after school.
words.ex_cn: 男孩放学后穿过一片玉米地。
words.en: A cornfield is a field in which corn is grown.

words.ex: The cornstalk is tall and green.
words.ex_cn: 玉米秆又高又绿。
words.en: A cornstalk is the stem of a corn plant, which remains after the corn has been harvested.

words.tr:
v. 发劈啪声；发尖而轻的爆裂声
n. 劈啪响；裂纹
words.ex: The fire crackles in the hearth.
words.ex_cn: 壁炉里的火噼啪作响。
words.en: If something crackles, it makes a rapid series of short, sharp noises.

words.ex: The children played near the creek after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在小河旁玩耍。
words.en: A creek is a small, narrow stream or river.

words.tr:
n. 冠；顶部
v. 到达顶部；到达最高点
words.ex: The rooster has a bright red crest.
words.ex_cn: 公鸡有一个鲜红的冠。
words.en: The highest part of a hill or mountain; the top of a wave; a tuft or growth of feathers or skin on the head of a bird or other animal.

words.tr:
n. 瓦罐；碎瓦片；老朽的人
v. 使衰弱；使身体垮掉
words.ex: She used an old crock to store her homemade pickles.
words.ex_cn: 她用一个旧坛子来存放自制的泡菜。
words.en: A crock is a pot or jar made of baked clay, or it can refer to something that is old and not in good condition.

words.tr:
v. （使）突然移动；快速投掷；
n. 镖；
words.ex: The cat darted across the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫突然冲过房间。
words.en: A dart is a small, narrow object with a sharp point which can be thrown or shot. It can also mean to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.

words.tr: v. 刺绣；绣（花）；加以渲染（或润色）
words.ex: She embroiders flowers on the pillow.
words.ex_cn: 她在枕头上刺绣花朵。
words.en: To embroider means to decorate cloth or other material by sewing patterns or pictures on it with colored threads.

words.tr:
n. 绒毛
v. 使松软；搞砸
words.ex: The cat's fur is full of fluff.
words.ex_cn: 猫的毛上全是绒毛。
words.en: Fluff can refer to soft fibers from fabrics or the like, or to something of little importance or substance. It can also mean to make something fluffy or to make a mistake.

words.ex: She wore a necklace of garnet beads.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一串石榴石珠子的项链。
words.en: A garnet is a type of hard, often red, semi-precious stone used in jewelry.

words.ex: The goldfinch is a small, brightly colored bird.
words.ex_cn: 金翅雀是一种色彩鲜艳的小鸟。
words.en: A goldfinch is a small bird with a yellow body and black and white wings, known for its melodious song.

words.ex: He painted a gourd for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他为节日画了一个葫芦。
words.en: A gourd is a large fruit with a hard skin, often used for decoration or as a container.

words.tr: adj. 朦胧的；模糊的；不清楚的
words.ex: The sky looks hazy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上天空看起来雾蒙蒙的。
words.en: If it is hazy, it is not clear because there is a lot of mist, smoke, or dust in the air.

words.ex: He cooked the meat over hickory wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用山核桃木烤肉。
words.en: A hickory is a type of tree that is native to North America, known for its hard wood and edible nuts.

words.ex: He responded with a ho-hum, clearly not interested.
words.ex_cn: 他以一声“ho-hum”回应，显然不感兴趣。
words.en: If you describe something as ho-hum, you mean that it is boring, uninteresting, or unexciting.

words.ex: He felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到妒忌。
words.en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.tr: n. 赏叶（指观赏秋季树叶变色）
words.ex: In the fall, many people enjoy leaf-peeping in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 秋天，许多人喜欢去山里赏叶。
words.en: Leaf-peeping is the activity of traveling to view and photograph the fall foliage in areas where leaves change colors in the autumn.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.ex: The maple leaves turn red in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 枫树的叶子在秋天变红。
words.en: A maple is a tree or shrub with lobed leaves, winged fruits, and colorful autumn foliage, which is often cultivated for its sap, wood, or ornamental value.

words.tr:
v. 缓慢而弯曲地流动；漫步；闲聊
n. 河流的曲折；漫步；迂回曲折的进程
words.ex: The river meanders through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这条河蜿蜒穿过森林。
words.en: To meander means to follow a winding and turning course, often used to describe the way a river flows or the way a person walks without a clear direction.

words.ex: They placed a memorial at the site of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们在事故地点放置了一座纪念物。
words.en: A memorial is a structure or event established to remind people of a person or event.

words.ex: Mum made me a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈给我做了一个三明治当午餐。
words.en: A mother; silent or not speaking.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 栎树矗立在后院。
words.en: An oak is a large tree that is common in northern countries. Oaks have strong wood and are often used for making furniture.

words.ex: The two countries made a pact to stop fighting.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家达成了一项停止战斗的协议。
words.en: A pact is a formal agreement between two or more people, organizations, or governments to do a particular thing or to help each other.

words.tr: n. 一阵剧痛；突然而强烈的情感
words.ex: He felt a pang of guilt after lying.
words.ex_cn: 他说谎后感到一阵内疚。
words.en: A pang is a sudden strong feeling of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: The quilt is a patchwork of old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这条被子是用旧衣服拼凑而成的。
words.en: Patchwork is a form of needlework that involves sewing together pieces of fabric into a larger design. The larger design is usually based on repeating patterns built up with different fabric shapes (which can be different colors).

words.ex: The statue was placed on a marble pedestal.
words.ex_cn: 雕像被放置在大理石底座上。
words.en: A pedestal is the base or support on which a statue, obelisk, or column is mounted.

words.ex: He sits on the porch and drinks coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在门廊上喝咖啡。
words.en: A porch is a covered shelter projecting in front of the entrance of a building.

words.ex: He carved a big pumpkin for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 他为万圣节雕刻了一个大南瓜。
words.en: A pumpkin is a large, round, orange vegetable with a thick skin.

words.tr: n. 咆哮； adj. 极大的； v. “roar”的现在分词；
words.ex: The lion's roaring echoed through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狮子的咆哮在森林中回荡。
words.en: Making or uttering a loud, deep, or harsh prolonged sound.

words.ex: The old bike has rust on its chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧自行车的链条上有锈。
words.en: Rust is a reddish-brown substance that forms on the surface of iron or steel when they are exposed to air and moisture, causing them to corrode.

words.tr: n. 一种的胡桃树；胡桃树果实
words.ex: The shagbark hickory is known for its distinctive bark.
words.ex_cn: 这种胡桃树以其独特的树皮而闻名。
words.en: A type of hickory tree with shaggy bark, known scientifically as Carya ovata.

words.ex: The farmer tied the sheaf of wheat with rope.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用绳子把一束小麦捆在一起。
words.en: A sheaf is a bundle of grain stalks laid lengthwise and tied together after reaping.

words.ex: She wore a red skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色短裙去参加派对。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers part or all of the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to the act of moving along the edge of something.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.tr:
n. 球类运动（squash）；
v. 压碎；
words.ex: He plays squash every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友打壁球。
words.en: To squash something means to press or squeeze it so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. It can also refer to the sport of squash or a type of vegetable.

words.ex: The stillness of the night was broken by a sudden cry.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的沉静被一声突如其来的叫喊打破。
words.en: The absence of movement or sound; quietness and calm.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: He poured syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar in boiling water, often used as a topping for desserts or as a sweetener in drinks.

words.tr:
n. 小径；路径；踪迹；
v. 跟踪；尾随；落后于；
words.ex: We walked along the forest trail.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着森林小径散步。
words.en: A trail is a path through the countryside or through a forest, often made or used by people walking. As a verb, to trail means to follow someone or something secretly or to be behind in a race or competition.

words.tr:
v. 缓慢或吃力地走
n. 长途跋涉
words.ex: He trudges through the snow every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跋涉穿过雪地。
words.en: To walk slowly and with heavy steps, typically because of exhaustion or harsh conditions.

words.ex: She bought a wicker basket for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 她为野餐买了一个柳条篮子。
words.en: Wicker is the material made from weaving thin branches or twigs, especially from willows, used to make baskets, furniture, etc.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He leaves for work at 7 a.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上七点出发去上班。
words.en: To depart from a place to go to another.

words.tr: phrase. v. 偶然发现；偶然遇到
words.ex: I happened upon an old book in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 我在阁楼里偶然发现了一本旧书。
words.en: To find or meet someone or something by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 沉溺于（某种情绪或状态）；放纵自己于（尤指负面事物）
words.ex: He is wallowing in sadness after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 他在这段感情破裂后沉溺于悲伤中。
words.en: If you say that someone wallows in an unpleasant situation, you are criticizing them for being deliberately unhappy.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text A New Words

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: He read an anthology of short stories last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了一本短篇故事选集。
words.en: An anthology is a collection of writings, such as poems or stories, that have been chosen by someone because they are considered to be the best or most interesting examples of their kind.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.ex: The library keeps old newspapers in an archive.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案馆里。
words.en: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

words.ex: The audio signal was clear and loud.
words.ex_cn: 音频信号清晰响亮。
words.en: Audio refers to sound, especially when recorded, transmitted, or reproduced.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: He bind the books with string.
words.ex_cn: 他用绳子把书捆起来。
words.en: To tie something or someone tightly or to fasten something.

words.tr: adv. 共同地；集体地；总体地；
words.ex: The team worked collectively to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队共同合作完成了项目。
words.en: In a way that is done or shared by all members of a group of people.

words.ex: The software is highly customizable to meet various needs.
words.ex_cn: 该软件高度可定制，以满足各种需求。
words.en: Able to be modified or adjusted according to the user's preferences or requirements.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 厄运；毁灭；死亡
v. 注定；判决
words.ex: The old prophecy spoke of doom for the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 古老的预言说这个王国将遭遇厄运。
words.en: Doom is a terrible fate or destiny that you cannot avoid, especially death or destruction.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.tr: n. 增强；改善；增加；增进；
words.ex: The new software brings an enhancement to the system.
words.ex_cn: 新软件带来了系统的增强。
words.en: An enhancement is an improvement or addition that makes something better or more effective.

words.ex: He eats excessively sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多甜食。
words.en: To an excessive degree; more than is necessary, normal, or desirable; inordinately.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.tr: n. 天花乱坠的广告宣传；炒作；
words.ex: The new phone got a lot of hype before its release.
words.ex_cn: 这款新手机在发布前受到了大量天花乱坠的广告宣传。
words.en: If someone or something is hyped, they are praised or advertised a lot in newspapers, on television, etc., especially in a way that is intended to make them seem very exciting or important.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.tr: adj. 烦人的； v. “nag”的现在分词；
words.ex: The nagging sound of the alarm woke me up.
words.ex_cn: 烦人的闹钟声把我吵醒了。
words.en: If you describe someone as nagging, you mean that they keep asking or telling you to do something, in an annoying way.

words.ex: She prefers old-school jazz to modern electronic music.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢老派爵士乐，而不是现代电子音乐。
words.en: Old-school is used to describe something or someone that is traditional or old-fashioned, often in a way that is respected or admired.

words.tr: adj. 像洋葱皮一样薄的；极薄的
words.ex: The paper was so onionskin-thin that it was almost translucent.
words.ex_cn: 那张纸薄得几乎透明，就像洋葱皮一样。
words.en: Extremely thin, resembling the thinness of onion skin.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.ex: The teacher used pedagogical methods to help students learn.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师使用了教育学的方法来帮助学生学习。
words.en: Relating to the methods and theory of teaching.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: The predominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的主导颜色是蓝色。
words.en: If something is predominant, it is more important, noticeable, or powerful than the other things in a situation.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: This room is relatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with other similar things or with what you expect.

words.tr: n. 补救；纠正；补习；辅导
words.ex: The teacher gave extra help for remediation after the test.
words.ex_cn: 考试后，老师提供了额外帮助来进行补救。
words.en: The act of correcting something that is wrong or of repairing something that is damaged.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: There was a scramble for the last ticket.
words.ex_cn: 大家争相抢购最后一张票。
words.en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you. Scramble can also mean to compete or struggle with others for something that is in short supply.

words.ex: His sentiment about the new policy is positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对新政策的看法是积极的。
words.en: A sentiment is a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something.

words.ex: He tries to simplify the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简化这个数学问题。
words.en: If you simplify something, you make it easier to understand or you remove the things that make it complex.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 动词短语. 向某人呼吁；上诉；对某人有吸引力
words.ex: The idea of traveling around the world appeals to me.
words.ex_cn: 环游世界的想法吸引了我。
words.en: If something appeals to you, you find it attractive or interesting.

words.tr:
n. 捆；束；包
v. 匆匆送走
words.ex: He bought a bundle of newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一捆报纸。
words.en: A bundle is a number of things that are tied or wrapped together so that they can be carried or stored easily.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人引入；使某人卷入（某种情况或活动中）
words.ex: The scandal drew many politicians into its web.
words.ex_cn: 丑闻使许多政客卷入其中。
words.en: To involve someone in a situation or activity, often without their wanting to be involved.

words.ex: The story revolves around a boy who finds a magic stone.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事围绕一个发现魔法石的男孩展开。
words.en: To revolve around something means to have it as the main subject or purpose.

words.ex: I will stick with this plan.
words.ex_cn: 我会坚持这个计划。
words.en: To continue to support or use something, even though it may be difficult or you may want to change to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 翻页；比喻翻过人生新的一页，重新开始
words.ex: Please turn the page to read the next story.
words.ex_cn: 请翻页阅读下一个故事。
words.en: To move to the next page in a book or to start a new chapter in life, often implying a fresh start or moving on from past events.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text B New Words

words.ex: He uses Chrome as his browser.
words.ex_cn: 他用 Chrome 作为他的浏览器。
words.en: A browser is a piece of computer software that you use to search for information on the Internet.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.ex: He volunteers for civic projects in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他为家乡的市民项目做志愿者。
words.en: Relating to a city or town, especially its administration; relating to the duties or activities of people in relation to their town, city, or local area.

words.ex: The old computer is clunky and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧电脑笨重又缓慢。
words.en: If you describe something as clunky, you mean that it is heavy, awkward, and not efficient or elegant.

words.tr:
n. 成分；
adj. 构成的；
words.ex: Sugar is a constituent of soda.
words.ex_cn: 糖是苏打水的一种成分。
words.en: A constituent is a part of a whole. In politics, a constituent is a person who is represented by an elected official.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；外形；等高线
v. 画轮廓（画等高线）
adj. 显示轮廓的
words.ex: The map shows the contour of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山的轮廓。
words.en: The outline of a figure, body, or mass, especially the curved shape of a surface.

words.tr:
n. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
words.ex: The car crash happened at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碰撞发生在十字路口。
words.en: If a vehicle crashes or if the driver crashes it, it hits something and is damaged or destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 首次露面；初次登场
v. 初次登场；首次推出
words.ex: He made his debut on stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚在舞台上首次登台。
words.en: The debut of a performer or sports player is their first public performance, appearance, or recording.

words.ex: He buys books on e-commerce websites.
words.ex_cn: 他在电子商务网站上买书。
words.en: the buying and selling of goods and services on the Internet

words.tr: adv. 发疯般地；极其激动地
words.ex: The crowd cheered frenetically as the winner crossed the finish line.
words.ex_cn: 当获胜者冲过终点线时，人群发疯般地欢呼。
words.en: If you describe an activity as frenetic, you mean that it is fast and involves a lot of energy, but is often not very well organized.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: He is a guru in computer programming.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机编程方面的专家。
words.en: A guru is a person who is very skilled and knowledgeable in a particular subject, and who gives advice and guidance to others.

words.tr: n. 伊玛目（伊斯兰教的宗教领袖）
words.ex: The imam led the congregational prayers.
words.ex_cn: 伊玛目带领信众做集体祈祷。
words.en: An imam is a Muslim leader who leads the prayer in a mosque and is often considered a religious authority.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.tr:
v. 做实习生；扣留
n. 实习生
words.ex: He is interning at a hospital this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天在医院做实习生。
words.en: An intern is someone who works in a temporary position with an emphasis on on-the-job training rather than merely employment, often to gain experience in a particular field.

words.tr: v. 清算；变卖；消除；铲除
words.ex: The company will liquidate its assets to pay debts.
words.ex_cn: 公司将变卖资产来偿还债务。
words.en: To liquidate a company means to sell its assets in order to pay its debts, or to sell an asset for cash.

words.ex: He tries to mediate between the two friends.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在两个朋友之间调解。
words.en: To intervene between people or parties in order to bring about an agreement or reconciliation.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.ex: It was raining, nonetheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下着雨，尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Nonetheless is used to indicate that something is true or happens in spite of what has just been said.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；著名的；
words.ex: This is a notable achievement.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个值得注意的成就。
words.en: Worthy of attention or notice; remarkable.

words.tr:
n. 本堂牧师；（主管教堂的）牧师
v. 作…的牧师
words.ex: The pastor sings hymns every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 牧师每周日唱圣歌。
words.en: A pastor is a minister in charge of a Christian church or congregation.

words.tr: n. 入门；大门；入口网站
words.ex: This book is a portal to learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是学习英语的入门。
words.en: A portal is a large and imposing entrance, doorway, or gate, or a website that provides access or links to other sites.

words.ex: The puppy is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小狗在玩球。
words.en: A puppy is a young dog.

words.tr: n. 拉比；犹太的法学博士
words.ex: The rabbi teaches the children about Jewish traditions.
words.ex_cn: 拉比教孩子们关于犹太传统。
words.en: A rabbi is a Jewish scholar or teacher, especially one who studies or teaches Jewish law.

words.ex: The retailer sells clothes to customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家零售商向顾客出售衣服。
words.en: A retailer is a person or business that sells goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The sponge reached saturation and could not hold more water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵达到饱和，再也吸不下更多水了。
words.en: Saturation is the state or process that occurs when no more of something can be absorbed, combined with, or added.

words.ex: The settler built a house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这位定居者在河边建了一所房子。
words.en: A settler is a person who moves to a new place with the intention of staying there, especially in a previously uninhabited or sparsely inhabited area.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.tr:
v. 交换；
n. 交换；
words.ex: They swap books every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周交换书籍。
words.en: If you swap something with someone, you give it to them and receive a different thing in exchange.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: She maintains a weblog to share her thoughts and experiences.
words.ex_cn: 她维护一个博客来分享她的想法和经历。
words.en: A weblog is a website that contains an online personal journal with reflections, comments, and often hyperlinks provided by the writer.

words.tr:
v. 嗖嗖地移动；快速地做；匆匆地干
n. 嗖嗖声；能手
words.ex: The car whizzed past the traffic lights.
words.ex_cn: 汽车嗖嗖地从交通灯旁驶过。
words.en: If you describe someone as a whiz at something, you mean that they are extremely good at it.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语. 一批；一组（用于指同时生产或处理的一组物品或人）
words.ex: A batch of cookies is ready to be baked.
words.ex_cn: 一批饼干准备烘烤。
words.en: A quantity of something produced at one time.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: phrase. 与…结伴玩乐；与…厮混在一起
words.ex: They've been pal around together for years.
words.ex_cn: 他们已经一起玩了很多年了。
words.en: To spend time with someone in a friendly way, often doing things together.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （问题或情况）突然出现，冒出来
words.ex: Problems crop up when we don't plan ahead.
words.ex_cn: 当我们没有提前计划时，问题就会出现。
words.en: If something crops up, it appears or happens, usually unexpectedly.

words.w: from the cradle to the grave
words.tr: phrase. 从生到死；自摇篮至坟墓（指人的一生全过程）
words.uk: frɒm ðə ˈkreɪdl tuː ðə ɡreɪv
words.us: frəm ðə ˈkreɪdl tu ðə ɡreɪv
words.ex: The government's policy aims to support citizens from the cradle to the grave.
words.ex_cn: 政府的政策旨在支持公民从生到死。
words.en: From birth to death; throughout one's life.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点起床。
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A New Words

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: It is apparent that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is apparent, it seems to be true, although you cannot be certain that it is.

words.ex: The teacher gave an authoritative answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个权威性的回答。
words.en: If something is authoritative, it is respected and accepted as true or correct because it comes from a reliable source.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.ex: The river forms the border between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河是两个国家的边界。
words.en: The edge or boundary of something, or the part near it; a dividing line.

words.ex: The accident caused many casualties.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了许多伤亡人员。
words.en: A casualty is a person who is killed or injured in a war or in an accident.

words.tr:
n. 天主教徒；
adj. 天主教的；
words.ex: He is a catholic who goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每周日都去教堂的天主教徒。
words.en: If you describe a collection of things or people as catholic, you are emphasizing that it is varied and includes many different types of things or people.

words.ex: The rain ceased after an hour.
words.ex_cn: 一小时后，雨停了。
words.en: If something ceases, it stops happening or existing.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.ex: The movie is controversial because it shows violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因为展示暴力而有争议。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as controversial, you mean that they are the subject of intense public argument, disagreement, or disapproval.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.tr: adv. 人口统计地(demographic, demographical 的变形)
words.ex: The town is changing demographically.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇的人口结构正在发生变化。
words.en: In a way that relates to the structure of populations.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: The rich pay disproportionately more taxes.
words.ex_cn: 富人缴纳的税不成比例地更多。
words.en: To an extent that is too large or too small in comparison with something else.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.tr: adj. 富于企业家精神的；企业性质的；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneurial young man who started his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个富有企业家精神的年轻人，自己创办了公司。
words.en: Entrepreneurial refers to the characteristics or actions of someone who starts a business and is willing to risk loss in order to make money.

words.ex: She was immensely happy after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 她赢得奖品后极大地开心。
words.en: To an extremely great extent or degree.

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: Immigration to this country has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的移民数量最近增加了。
words.en: Immigration is the act of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.

words.tr: adj. 革新的；富有革新精神的；
words.ex: The company made an innovative phone.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司推出了一款革新的手机。
words.en: Something that is innovative is new and original, especially in the way that it is done.

words.ex: Honesty is an integral part of a good relationship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是良好关系中不可或缺的一部分。
words.en: Something that is integral is very important or necessary. If something is an integral part of a whole, it is an essential part of that whole.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.tr: n. 制造业； v. 制造；“manufacture”的现在分词；
words.ex: Manufacturing is important for the country's economy.
words.ex_cn: 制造业对国家经济很重要。
words.en: The process of converting raw materials into finished products, especially by means of a large-scale industrial operation.

words.ex: Birds begin migration in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在秋天开始迁徙。
words.en: The movement of people, animals, or birds from one place to another, especially regularly according to the seasons.

words.tr:
adj. 净余的；
n. 网；
words.ex: The net profit after taxes is $500.
words.ex_cn: 缴税后的净收益是500美元。
words.en: A net is a piece of thin fabric or thread that is used to catch fish, insects, or other small animals. It can also refer to the amount of money remaining after all expenses have been deducted.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: He sold his old car profitably.
words.ex_cn: 他以有利的方式卖掉了他的旧车。
words.en: In a way that results in or is likely to result in a profit or benefit.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.tr:
v. 滚动；
n. 滚动；卷形物；
words.ex: The ball roll down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 球从山上滚下来。
words.en: To move somewhere by turning over and over, or to make something move in this way.

words.tr:
n. 蔑视
v. 蔑视
words.ex: He looked at the lie with scorn.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.ex: The phone has a silicon chip inside.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机内部有一个硅芯片。
words.en: Silicon is a chemical element with the symbol Si and atomic number 14. It is a hard, brittle crystalline solid with a blue-grey metallic lustre, and is a tetravalent metalloid and semiconductor.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.ex: He won three successive championships.
words.ex_cn: 他连续赢得了三届冠军。
words.en: Following one after the other without interruption.

words.ex: The swamp is full of tall grass and frogs.
words.ex_cn: 这个沼泽里长满了高草和青蛙。
words.en: A swamp is an area of low-lying, uncultivated ground where water collects; a bog or marsh.

words.ex: The police caught the terrorist near the station.
words.ex_cn: 警察在车站附近抓住了这名恐怖分子。
words.en: A terrorist is a person who uses violent and intimidating methods in the pursuit of political aims.

words.ex: His testimony proved the suspect was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 他的证词证明了嫌疑人是无辜的。
words.en: A formal written or spoken statement, especially one given in a court of law.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；同化；融入（某社会、文化等）
words.ex: It can be hard to assimilate into a new culture.
words.ex_cn: 融入一种新文化可能很难。
words.en: To assimilate into a group or culture means to become part of it and be accepted by it, especially when you are different from it in some way.

words.ex: He tries to assimilate new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力吸收新单词。
words.en: To assimilate means to take in and understand fully ideas, information, or culture, or to make something become part of a group or system.

words.tr: phrase. 从…得到；从…召集或选择
words.ex: He draws from his experience to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他从自己的经验中汲取灵感来解决问题。
words.en: To take or obtain something from a particular source.

words.ex: He acted in the name of justice.
words.ex_cn: 他以正义的名义行动。
words.en: If you do something in the name of a particular cause or principle, you do it in order to support that cause or principle.

words.tr: phrase.  更不必说；不必提及
words.ex: He can run fast, not to mention jump high.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，更不用说跳得高了。
words.en: Used to introduce an additional point which reinforces the point being made.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 不成比例的；不相称的；过分的；过于严重的
words.ex: The punishment was out of proportion to the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 惩罚与错误不成比例。
words.en: If something is out of proportion, it is much bigger or more serious than it should be in comparison to something else.

words.w: out of all proportion to sth.
words.tr: phrase. phr. 与某事完全不成比例；相对于某事来说过分
words.ex: The punishment was out of all proportion to the crime.
words.ex_cn: 惩罚与罪行不成比例。
words.en: If something is out of all proportion to something else, it is much bigger or more important than it should be in relation to that other thing.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text B New Words

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.ex: She is a big fan of Japanese anime.
words.ex_cn: 她是日本动漫的忠实粉丝。
words.en: Anime is a style of Japanese film and television animation, typically aimed at adults as well as children.

words.tr:
v. 猛击；打；击
n. 敲打；猛击；影响力
words.ex: He clouted the ball with his bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒猛击了球。
words.en: Clout refers to the power or influence that someone has, especially in politics or business.

words.ex: Small commerce helps local towns grow.
words.ex_cn: 小商业有助于小镇的发展。
words.en: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.ex: The rain deepened the puddles on the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水加深了路上的水坑。
words.en: If a situation or emotion deepens or if something deepens it, it becomes stronger and more intense.

words.ex: People vote in democracy to choose their leaders.
words.ex_cn: 人们在民主制度下投票选择他们的领导人。
words.en: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.

words.ex: We ate dim sum for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我们早餐吃了点心。
words.en: Dim sum is a style of Chinese cuisine (particularly Cantonese) prepared as small bite-sized portions of food traditionally served in small steamer baskets or on small plates.

words.tr: n. 就餐者；小餐馆；餐车
words.ex: The diner ate a burger and fries quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位就餐者快速吃了一个汉堡和薯条。
words.en: A diner is a person who is eating a meal, especially in a restaurant. It can also refer to a small, informal restaurant.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.tr: adj. 新兴的； v. 浮现；显露；“emerge”的现在分词；
words.ex: China has many emerging tech companies.
words.ex_cn: 中国有许多新兴的科技公司。
words.en: An emerging market, country, or economy is one that is beginning to grow and develop its industries and infrastructure.

words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通拥堵。
words.en: Expansion refers to the process of becoming larger or more extensive.

words.ex: This phone is the flagship model of the company.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机是该公司的旗舰型号。
words.en: The most important product, service, or project of a company or organization.

words.tr:
v. 轻弹；轻击；轻拂；忽然摇动
n. 轻弹；轻拂；快速的轻打
words.ex: He flicked the light switch on.
words.ex_cn: 他 flick 了一下电灯开关。
words.en: To move or hit something with a quick, sharp movement.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.tr: n. 地缘政治学；地理政治论
words.ex: He studies geopolitics to understand world conflicts.
words.ex_cn: 他学习地缘政治以理解世界冲突。
words.en: Geopolitics is the study of the effects of geography (human and physical) on international politics and international relations.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.ex: Globalization helps countries trade more easily.
words.ex_cn: 全球化帮助各国更容易地进行贸易。
words.en: The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.

words.ex: The company wants to globalize its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想将业务全球化。
words.en: To make something worldwide in scope or application.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.tr: adj. 包容的；包含全部费用的；
words.ex: The school is inclusive and welcomes all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是包容的，欢迎所有学生。
words.en: Inclusive is used to describe something that is designed to include all types of people, things, or ideas, and to treat them all fairly and equally.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.tr:
adj. 奢侈的；慷慨给予的；挥霍的；过多的
v. 浪费；挥霍；慷慨给予
words.ex: He threw a lavish party for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的生日举办了一场奢华的派对。
words.en: If you describe something as lavish, you mean that it is very elaborate and impressive and a lot of money has been spent on it. If you say that someone is lavish in the way they behave, you mean that they give, spend, or use a lot of something.

words.ex: He believes in marxism and supports workers' rights.
words.ex_cn: 他相信马克思主义，并支持工人的权利。
words.en: Marxism is a method of socioeconomic analysis that views class relations and social conflict using a materialist interpretation of historical development and takes a dialectical view of social transformation.

words.ex: He had a meager meal after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后吃了一顿很少的饭。
words.en: If you describe an amount or quantity of something as meager, you are critical of it because it is very small or not enough.

words.tr: adj. 多边的；多国参加的
words.ex: The multilateral agreement helped many countries work together.
words.ex_cn: 这个多边协议帮助许多国家共同合作。
words.en: Involving or agreed upon by three or more parties, especially the governments of different countries.

words.tr: n. 反对者；否定者；爱唱反调的人
words.ex: Despite the naysayers, she managed to achieve her goals.
words.ex_cn: 尽管有那些摇头族，她还是设法实现了自己的目标。
words.en: A naysayer is someone who always says something will not work or is not possible.

words.ex: The two sides started negotiation to solve the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 双方开始了谈判以解决冲突。
words.en: Negotiation is a discussion aimed at reaching an agreement.

words.tr: n. 建立人际关系网；网络化；
words.ex: He went to the party for networking.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加聚会是为了建立人际关系网。
words.en: The process of interacting with others to exchange information and develop professional or social contacts.

words.ex: He will offload the boxes onto the truck.
words.ex_cn: 他将把箱子卸到卡车上。
words.en: To offload means to transfer or shift a responsibility or burden to someone else, or to unload goods from a vehicle or ship.

words.tr: adj. 单程的；单行道的；单方面的
words.ex: This is a one-way street.
words.ex_cn: 这是一条单行道。
words.en: A one-way trip or ticket is for travel to a place only, not for going and coming back.

words.ex: The new car can outpace the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这辆新车能超过旧车。
words.en: To outpace someone or something means to perform a particular action faster or better than they do.

words.ex: He showed his portfolio to the art teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向美术老师展示了他作品集。
words.en: A portfolio is a set of pictures by someone, or photographs of examples of their work, which they use when entering competitions or applying for work.

words.ex: The computer has a fast processor.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有一个快速的处理器。
words.en: A processor is a part of a computer that interprets and carries out instructions.

words.ex: Rabbits proliferate quickly in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在野外繁殖得很快。
words.en: If something proliferates, it increases in number or spreads quickly.

words.tr: adj. 再次发生的；再次兴起的；更新的； v. 更新；“renew”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The conflict was renewed after the peace talks failed.
words.ex_cn: 和平谈判失败后，冲突再次发生。
words.en: If something is renewed, it is made new again or replaced so that it is like new.

words.tr: v. 重新迁回：指将生产线、业务或工作从海外迁回本国。
words.ex: The company decided to reshore its manufacturing operations to reduce costs.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定将其制造业务迁回国内以降低成本。
words.en: To bring back (a business or production operation) to the country from which it was previously moved.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.tr:
n. 摊位；
v. 故意拖延；
words.ex: He sells fruits at a stall in the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场的一个摊位上卖水果。
words.en: A stall is a small open-fronted shop or a compartment for one animal in a stable or barn. As a verb, it means to stop or cause to stop making progress.

words.tr: adj. 以历史画装饰的；历史上有名的；分层的
words.ex: The storied castle has been a landmark for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这座历史悠久的城堡几个世纪以来一直是地标。
words.en: Having a history or background that is well known or celebrated.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: He works in the telecom industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在电信行业工作。
words.en: Telecom refers to the technology and industry involved in communication over distances by cable, telegraph, telephone, or broadcasting.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. （因精力耗尽而）失去动力；泄劲；逐渐减弱
words.ex: He ran out of steam during the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中跑着跑着就没力气了。
words.en: To lose energy or enthusiasm and be unable to continue an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 受欢迎的；备受追捧的；被人争相寻求的
words.ex: This vintage car is highly sought after by collectors.
words.ex_cn: 这辆复古车被收藏家们高度追求。
words.en: To be desired or wanted by many people.

words.tr: phrase. 即将做某事；准备做某事
words.ex: The team is set to win the championship this year.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍今年有望赢得冠军。
words.en: If someone is set to do something, they are ready to do it or are likely to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.tr: phrase. 强行插手；强行挤入；以强硬手段介入
words.ex: He tried to muscle in on the negotiations.
words.ex_cn: 他试图强行介入谈判。
words.en: To force one's way into a situation or activity, especially in an unwelcome or intrusive manner.

words.tr: phrase. 强行插手；强行介入；硬挤进（某事）
words.ex: He tried to muscle in on the negotiations.
words.ex_cn: 他试图强行加入谈判。
words.en: To force your way into a situation where you are not welcome or have not been invited, especially in order to gain some advantage.
